agents.name: Knowledge Summarizer
agents.description: Reads the scoped slice of a company's DecisionGraph memory and produces a short summary of what is known, highlighting the highest-confidence item.

agents.name: Topic Coverage Counter
agents.description: Counts how many decisions exist per requested topic and reports the average confidence per topic.

agents.name: Knowledge QA Analyst
agents.description: Skilled retrieval agent. Reads BOTH decisions and PDF/URL-ingested knowledge-graph triples in the approved scope, scores them against the task question (BM25-ish), and returns a cited one-line answer with the top supporting evidence.

agents.name: Knowledge QA Analyst (MCP)
agents.description: Same skill as the retrieval analyst, but reaches the knowledge graph LIVE via MCP tool calls (recall / scoped_search) over JSON-RPC stdio. Every call is scope-gated and audited.

agents.name: Mesh Tool Provider
agents.description: Long-lived MCP agent that exposes utility tools (calculate, word_count, base64_encode) to peers in the same orchestration run. Other agents discover and call them via list_peer_tools / call_peer_tool. Use as a member of an Orchestration -> Dialog or Mesh run.

agents.name: Dialog Participant
agents.description: Long-lived MCP-speaking agent for multi-agent debates. Forms an opinion, broadcasts it, listens for peers' messages, responds for N rounds, and synthesizes a closing position. Use as a member of an Orchestration→Dialog run.

agents.name: ReAct Knowledge Analyst
agents.description: LLM-powered ReAct agent: THINK -> ACT (query_graph) -> OBSERVE loop. Reasons over the company's DecisionGraph using the configured LLM gateway and produces a multi-paragraph answer with citations to past decisions and graph triples.
